text:
alex g: Quick heads-up — planning a micro launch this month: 'Starter Components — inference patterns for edge apps'. Goal: blog post + 30m webinar + 2 short step-by-step tutorials + a GitHub sample repo. Target date next Wed. Who can take what?

maria r: Love that. Can we tie a bench narrative to it? e.g., show latency & cost for naive vs. cached KV/continuous batching. Short graphs, one table.

sam t: I can run the bench sweep. Will need the model (quantized small LLM) and a representative trace. Point me at the trace or I'll synth one. ETA 48h.

linh: I'll own the tutorials and repo. Plan: tutorial A = local dev + Docker, tutorial B = deploy to Dedicated + small config. Drafts by Monday EOD.

alex g: Great. Marketing asks: 1) final blog copy by Tues, 2) slide deck + demo script by Wed morning, 3) sign-up page + UTM. We'll promote via community newsletter + X + Discord.

maria r: Bench ask — include a tiny perf table and a sentence about unit economics. Also capture a simple prompt set (3 prompts) for regressions.

sam t: Using the small quant model from GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/example-models (placeholder). Bench plan: 3 seq lengths, 1000 samples each, measure p95 latency + tokens/sec + cost delta.

alex g: For inbound flow: webinar signups -> form with checkbox 'interested in Dedicated/private' -> route to sales queue tag `community-webinar`. @marketing-bot can you add the routing rule?

marketing-bot: Created draft calendar invite and signup form. Added task in Notion: https://www.notion.so/redwood/mini-launch-starter-components (edit access). Created a placeholder Zap to tag new leads with `community-webinar`.

linh: For the repo, I'll include a tiny README and two notebooks. Names: `local-quickstart.md` and `deploy-dedicated.md`. Will add a simple CI workflow to run the smoke test.

maria r: Suggested social copy (short):
```
New guide: Starter Components — practical inference patterns for edge apps. Learn how to lower latency & cost with smart caching and batching. Webinar Wed. RSVP: <signup link>?utm_source=community
```

alex g: Nice. For tracking, ensure `utm_campaign=starter-components-microlaunch` and add `?ref=community-newsletter` where appropriate. Also we should A/B subject lines: "Make inference cheap at the edge" vs "3 patterns to cut LLM latency 2x".

sam t: I'll upload bench artifacts to the repo under `bench/` and add a short notebook to reproduce figures.

linh: Cool. I'll start a PR by tomorrow with skeleton, pinging reviewers @alex g @maria r. :thumbsup:

alex g: Thanks everyone — I'll do the webinar landing page + coordinate timing with growth. Quick reminder: keep the blog <700 words and link to the tutorials for deeper steps. :party-parrot:
